items.title: Properties of the functor from quasi-coherent modules to modules on a big or small site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a topology tau among Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf, the lemma collects ten properties of the functors sending a quasi-coherent module to the associated module on the big and on the small tau-site: full faithfulness, commutation with direct sums and colimits, right exactness, exactness for the small etale site, failure of exactness for the big site in general, compatibility with tensor products, compatibility with internal hom for etale and Zariski in the small case, failure of that compatibility in the big case, and quasi-coherence of the middle term of a short exact sequence between associated modules (statement lines 3255-3307). The proof is a genuine assembly: colimit compatibility comes from recognizing the construction as a pullback of ringed sites, left exactness for the small etale site from flatness of etale morphisms, and the two failures are established by explicit counterexamples over the spectrum of the integers, where multiplication by two is injective but not so on the big site, and where the internal hom of a cokernel is a nonzero torsion sheaf on one side and zero on the other (proof lines 3309-3375). The most substantial part is the last one, which reduces to affine opens, uses the vanishing of the first cohomology of the associated module to get right exactness on the small site, and then proves universal injectivity of the map on sections by testing against square-zero algebras (proof lines 3377-3423). The claim is H3: two independent counterexample constructions and a genuinely original reduction in the last part, none of which is a citation chain.
